correctness.rationale: The exact disjoint ending-symbol DP gives a 3x3 affine period matrix with determinant polynomial and numerator explicitly computed. At x=1 its total-count rational GF differentiates to a series with strictly positive coefficients for p=ab>=1 and fixed s=a+b, proving the unique balanced split. The positive simple dominant pole gives the exact exponential rate. Independent-value brute force (73 cases), matrix/recurrence agreement (112), and finite run-balance (190) supplement the all-parameter symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Run-periodic binary words are natural structured sources between constant runs and alternating words. The result resolves all length-resolved unique-subsequence counts at arbitrary period count and proves a unique optimizer for every positive repetition count under fixed two-run period length. The growth base depends exactly on ab, exposing a product invariant and a nontrivial constrained extremal principle beyond a standard dynamic-programming identity.
